name: TituStoreBot @SarveshhRathod
description: Telegram Media Files & Document Storing Bot with a Permanent Shareable Link — now with unlimited multi-database MongoDB storage.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your bot token, as a string.

DB_CHANNEL_ID.description: Telegram channel ID where files get stored (must be private, bot must be admin).

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (e.g. from MongoDB Atlas free tier).

MONGO_URI2.description: Optional: a second MongoDB URI. The bot switches to it automatically once MONGO_URI fills up.

UPDATE_CHANNEL.description: Your bot updates channel username without @ (force-sub). Leave empty to disable.

AUTH_USERS.description: Space separated authorized user/channel ids, only used if IS_PRIVATE is True.

IS_PRIVATE.description: Set to True to restrict the bot to AUTH_USERS only.
